Class Player

java.lang.Object
ass2.ass2_jfx.model.Person
ass2.ass2_jfx.model.Player
public class Player extends Person
Represents a player in the application. A Player contains: - A unique name - The amount of money earned - The current tier level This class can be used in both: - Design Mode (CRUD management) - Play Mode (gameplay logic)
Version:
Java 21
Author:
Shane O'Connell, Joshua MacPherson
